version.approval_notes:
Build (Node.js 20+): npm ci && npm run vendor && npm run build. The vendored runtime
(extension/vendor/, from @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1) is unchanged since 1.3.0; see the notes
on 1.4.2 for its provenance and the two DANGEROUS_EVAL warnings it produces.

This version changes the icon only: new artwork, shipped as PNG at 16, 32, 48, 96 and 128 px
(extension/icons/, with icon.svg and a hand-hinted icon-16.svg as sources) instead of a single
SVG, and the popup header now shows that icon. No change to code paths, permissions or network
access.

release_notes.en-US:
New icon — a sound wave above the caption line it becomes — drawn separately for the 16 px
toolbar size so it stays sharp there.
release_notes.zh-CN: 新图标：一段声波，下面是它变成的那行字幕。16px 工具栏尺寸单独按像素对齐绘制，工具栏上也清晰。
